title: Tuition Payment Portal
scenario: An email says your tuition failed and gives a new payment link with a same-day deadline.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Tuition Payment Portal: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Payment issues belong inside the official student finance portal.
